one_line_answer.text: The review cycle is a series of steps that will help you review assessment.

cites.quote: This module takes you through a series of steps called The Review Cycle that will help you review assessment.

bangla_explanation: Assessment শেষ হলেই কাজ শেষ না, পুরো process review করতে হয়।
Review cycle-এর পাঁচটা ধাপ: Prepare, Plan, Conduct, Record আর Evaluate।
এতে বোঝা যায় কী ঠিক হলো আর কী ভুল হলো, তাই পরেরবার আরও ভালো করা যায়।
নিজের reflection-ই review-এর সবচেয়ে ভালো উৎস।

example.en: After a welding assessment, the assessor plans a review. He checks the assessor decisions and appeals procedures. Then he writes recommendations.
example.bn: ওয়েল্ডিং assessment-এর পর কী ভালো হলো, কী ভুল হলো দেখে report লেখা।

mnemonic.text: Please Plan Carefully, Report, Evaluate → P-P-C-R-E
mnemonic.explain_bn: প্রতিটি অক্ষর একটি ধাপ: Prepare, Plan, Conduct, Record and report, Evaluate।

list_answer.title: Steps of the review cycle

cites.quote: 1. Prepare for the review
2. Plan the review
3. Conduct the review
4. Record and report results
5. Evaluate the review process

items_bn: Review-এর প্রস্তুতি নিন — কী ঠিক হলো আর কী ভুল হলো, তা নিয়ে ভাবুন।
Review-এর পরিকল্পনা করুন — কী, কেন আর কীভাবে review হবে, তা আগে ঠিক করুন।
Review-এর ফলাফল লিখে রাখুন ও report করুন।
শেষে পুরো review process কেমন হলো, তা মূল্যায়ন করুন — এতে পরেরবার আরও ভালো করা যায়।

traps.text: Reviewing the assessment event is an important role of the assessor.

cites.quote: Reviewing the assessment event is an important role of the assessor.

traps.text: Evaluation also means looking back on your own performance to see how to improve.

cites.quote: The second stage of the evaluation process involves looking back on your own performance to see how it could be improved.

traps.text: The best source of information for review should come from your own reflection.

cites.quote: The best source of information for review or evaluation should come from your own reflections.

visual.title: The review cycle (p.31-33)
visual.title_bn: Review cycle: পাঁচটি ধাপ, ঘুরে আবার শুরু

items.text: Prepare for the review: share what went right and what went wrong.

cites.quote: 1. Prepare for the review
Reviewing to share what went right and what went wrong.

items.text: Plan the review: purpose, scope, stakeholders, criteria, evidence, methods and resources.

cites.quote: 2. Plan the review
What is the purpose and scope of the review?
Who are the relevant stakeholders for the review?
What criteria will form the basis of the review?
What evidence am I going to collect?
What methods of gathering evidence am I going to use?
What resources will I need?

items.text: Conduct the review: assessor selection and decisions, procedures, records, reporting and appeals.

cites.quote: 3. Conduct the review
Assessor selection
Assessor decisions
Assessment procedures
Record keeping procedures
Reporting mechanisms
Appeals procedures

items.text: Record and report results under the report headings. Include issues arising and recommendations.

cites.quote: 4. Record and report results
you should use the following headings
The issues arising from the review
Recommendations to the organisation

items.text: Evaluate the review process, looking back on your own performance too.

cites.quote: 5. Evaluate the review process
looking back on your own performance to see how it could be improved.

labels_bn: Review-এর প্রস্তুতি — কী ঠিক হয়েছে আর কী ভুল হয়েছে, তা খোলাখুলি ভাগ করে নিন।
Review-এর পরিকল্পনা — purpose, scope, stakeholders, criteria, evidence, methods আর resources ঠিক করুন।
Review পরিচালনা — assessor selection ও decisions, procedures, records, reporting আর appeals খতিয়ে দেখুন।
Report headings মেনে results লিখুন ও report করুন — উঠে আসা issues আর recommendations সহ।
শেষে পুরো review process মূল্যায়ন করুন, নিজের performance নিয়েও ভাবুন।

short.prompt: Outline the stages of a review cycle.
short.modelAnswer:
The review cycle helps you review assessment. Its stages are:
1. Prepare for the review
2. Plan the review
3. Conduct the review
4. Record and report results
5. Evaluate the review process

keyPoints.text: Plan: ask about the purpose and scope, stakeholders, criteria and evidence.

cites.quote: 2. Plan the review
What is the purpose and scope of the review?
Who are the relevant stakeholders for the review?
What criteria will form the basis of the review?
What evidence am I going to collect?

keyPoints.text: Conduct: assessor selection, assessor decisions, procedures, record keeping, reporting and appeals.

cites.quote: 3. Conduct the review Issues and strategies for conducting the review:
Assessor selection Assessor decisions Assessment procedures Record keeping procedures Reporting mechanisms Appeals procedures

keyPoints.text: The report includes issues arising from the review and recommendations to the organisation.

cites.quote: The issues arising from the review Recommendations to the organisation
When writing your report you should use the following headings

viva.prompt: Why should an assessor review the assessment process?

answer.text: To meet the needs of the people and the institutions. And to keep improving assessment practices.

cites.quote: You should ensure that the needs of the people involved, as well as the needs of the institutions, are met and that you are continually improving your assessment practices.
